name: DialValet API (current beta implementation)
description: Reference for the routes deployed in the current beta. POST /calls requires per-account authorization, a verified caller ID, available prepaid credit, and passing account limits. Current beta is U.S.-only. See https://dialvalet.com/docs/API.md for the human summary.
